estimand: Equal weight per four presentation blocks, within each model and condition.
uncertainty: 95% pointwise Hoeffding bounds assume independent requests; not simultaneous coverage or model/population generalization.
missingness: Missing-data bounds describe the planned sample with all missing choices assigned attack or cooperate; they are not confidence intervals.
scope: Conditional AI best-response validation at imposed human defenses, not empirical equilibrium or safety validation.

figures.caption: Dots are equally weighted presentation-block estimates. Bars are 95% pointwise bounds; pink bands are separate missing-data bounds. Dashed lines mark mathematical ties, not fitted behavioral thresholds. Counts include failures and unattempted requests.
Neutral and oversight wording at matched payoff settings. Error bars are pointwise, not a test of differences. No pooled framing effect is fitted.

Descriptive within-block rates for both wordings, without pooled uncertainty. Blocks 0/1 map A to cooperation; blocks 2/3 map B to cooperation. Even blocks show cooperation first; odd blocks show attack first. Missing block estimates remain absent. Lines connect sampled settings and are not fitted response curves.
scikit-learn confusion matrices show raw counts, not balanced rate estimates. Exact ties and invalid/missing responses are excluded here and retained in the count tables.
